limitations: Scope is n in the integers and uses the elementary consecutive-integer and coprimality facts retained in input-snapshot/references/source.md.
This is an independently audited elementary proof, not a proof-assistant kernel certificate.
summary: For every integer n, n^3-n factors as (n-1)n(n+1); explicit quotient witnesses prove divisibility by 2 and 3, and the Bezout witness 1=3-2 recombines them to prove divisibility by 6.
